OAT-01/S21.detail: desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 55 judged check(s) passed, 13 failed. Sign-in (and its code step, delivery stubbed), agreements for an account without consent, Settings. Field labels, checkbox names (== visible text), Continue/Decline names all pass. T12 (looks like the current app) is for a person: screenshots plus vision/design findings.

failed.example: button "Resend code" is 297×16 (< 24 px, WCAG 2.5.8); button "Use a different email" is 297×16 (< 24 px, WCAG 2.5.8)

OAT-01/S21.manual: T12 design look — a person compares the Settings and agreements screenshots with the current app (vision-review suspicions in vision/design).
OAT-01/S21.productIssue: On the sign-in code step, 'Resend code' and 'Use a different email' are 16 px-tall stacked text buttons, on the edge of the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception: they fail it in the iPhone 15 WebKit emulation (297×16) and pass it in Chromium (Pixel 7, 316×16), about a pixel of line height apart — confirm on a real iPhone before filing it as iPhone-specific. Contrast: the 'Round Companion — Physician Access Only' footer and the Send-code button (white on teal) fail AA on sign-in; Settings has an unnamed close (X) button. Breaks the oracle 'axe count = 0 … tap = 0 per screen and profile'.
